texts.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass]”威胁……
texts.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as "repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]". Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass] threat"...

texts.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，我们再也无法忽视这一事实：我们正要面对的是一个机器人社会。这些消息被泄露到公众视野当中只是时间的问题。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“机械威胁”……
texts.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], we could no longer deny it: we are dealing with a society of robots. It was only a matter of time before this knowledge was leaked to the wider public. The revelation has provoked widespread horror amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as "repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]". Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "mechanical threat"...

label.en: They can't be THAT bad, surely.
